Overview
 Job Description
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
As a Software QA Engineer at Keysight Technologies, you will be part of a dynamic development team that delivers test automation solutions for advanced network testing products.
 Responsibilities
Plan features by translating Product Management requirements into engineering test documentation
Estimate effort accurately and define testing strategies and plans
Execute testing for major features, ensuring test case execution, progress tracking, and status reporting
Integrate AI tools in QA activities: automated regression debug using AI tools, test cases ( Jira) generation and test scripts automation using AI
Code changes and automation framework development using AI
Monitor progress for minor releases (patches, hotfixes), flag delays, and suggest mitigation plans
Define system test scenarios and contribute to FS/TP reviews and feature documentation
Translate Marketing Feature/Product Requirements (FRD/PRD) into test cases
Provide input and support in customer support escalations
Configure and troubleshoot both KT and non-KT (Keysight Technologies) equipment independently
Provide technical supervision and guidance to other QA Engineers
Debug complex issues and apply advanced troubleshooting techniques
Suggest and implement enhancements to automation frameworks and processes
Develop automated test scripts using scripting languages and automation harnesses
Communicate effectively and collaborate with QA, Development, and cross-functional teams
Participate in Agile team meetings and propose process improvements
Perform root cause analysis and create detailed bug reports with clear reproduction steps and logs
 Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics, or related field.
Minimum 2 years of experience in software QA or test automation.
Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python) and experience with automation frameworks.
Solid understanding of software QA practices, SDLC, and source code management tools (e.g., Git).
Experience configuring and debugging KT and non-KT equipment independently.
Proven ability to work on moderately complex assignments with minimal supervision.
 Nice To Have Qualifications
Experience with Keysight or Ixia products and technologies.
Familiarity with networking protocols and systems.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Docker).
Knowledge of compilers, debuggers, and development tools.
Experience mentoring or supervising QA engineers.
Exposure to Agile development environments
Hands-on experience with AI tools
